name: dineflow
description: DineFlow - Full-Stack Multi-Tenant Restaurant Management System

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
